name: The Philosopher's War
source:
A woman (supposedly you) finds herself in a strange realm where she meets ancient philosophers like Plato, Thales and Heraclitus. Apparently, they want her to become their apprentice... 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20983]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个女人（据说就是你）发现自己身处奇异领域，在那里遇见了柏拉图、泰勒斯和赫拉克利特等古代哲学家。

他们似乎想让她成为自己的学徒……

[来自 [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20983]Lemma Soft 论坛[/url]]
